review.evidenceBasis: Checked all 65 mapping rows (65 videos, lessonRef null) against the 22 spec points of the CIE 9709 Mechanics spine (4.1-4.5), title-only evidence, applying the higher cross-subject physics->maths-mechanics bar. Every bound title names spec-listed content (identify forces, resultants, Newton's laws, scalar/vector quantities, s-t/v-t graphs, SUVAT, momentum and its conservation, work/GPE/KE/power), and the lane correctly left 4.1.3, 4.1.5, 4.2.3, 4.4.4, 4.5.5 unbound since no title evidences equilibrium, smooth contact, calculus kinematics, connected particles or car-on-hill maths. No spec-level rejects: the weakest bindings (e.g. 'Contact and Non-contact Forces'->4.1.4, 'Elastic, Inelastic Collisions'->4.3.2, GCSE/KS3 friction->4.1.6) are genuine partials already held at low/medium and stay.
